note: Bindings compose catalog listings and funnels into bounded packets. Source terms still win. This file does not invent buyers, acceptances, or cash.

in_scope: Measured failure cycle on one buyer-owned workflow
Durable receipt in the agreed sandbox

default_acceptance_rows.given: The named buyer-owned workflow and agreed sandbox
default_acceptance_rows.when: The agreed failure, retry, and rollback cycle is forced
default_acceptance_rows.then: The workflow survives and a durable receipt is hashed

in_scope: Original, ablated, and byte-exact restored hashes
Baseline, ablation, and restore harness logs
Concise finding and hashed delivery receipt

default_acceptance_rows.then: Rollback evidence passes; metric lift is not the rule

default_acceptance_rows.given: Legally controlled GGUF family and customer harness
default_acceptance_rows.when: The agreed pilot package is delivered
default_acceptance_rows.then: Ablation and edit are reversible and customer-harness evaluations run

in_scope: One pull request for the named public issue
ho-issue-to-pr.refund_text: If work never starts after written intake, founder refunds the authorized amount. If CI never greens or the PR never merges, the second half is withheld. A style disagreement is not a refund.

default_acceptance_rows.then: PR merged to the default branch, CI green on the integrated SHA, named issue closed by that PR

ho-meeting-packet.refund_text: If the packet is not delivered before the named meeting date because the provider missed the clock, founder refunds. Buyer-late inputs move the clock. A policy disagreement is not a refund.

default_acceptance_rows.given: Named meeting and public source artifact
default_acceptance_rows.then: Meeting name and date are written, packet is openly reachable, claims cite public sources or say UNMEASURED

in_scope: Filled questionnaire returned through the founder-sent private contact
ho-security-questionnaire.refund_text: If the filled copy is not returned in 10 days after complete inputs, founder refunds. Missing buyer attachments move the clock. A failed third-party audit is not this SKU.

default_acceptance_rows.then: Every required cell is filled or UNMEASURED, no certification is invented, public receipt contains no private answers

in_scope: Speak line linked to a public post
ho-pixel-pack.refund_text: If no sprite lands on the named public page in 5 days after intake, founder refunds. Art-direction churn after acceptance is a change order.

default_acceptance_rows.given: Named public page and sprite job
default_acceptance_rows.then: Sprite is visible, walk loop runs, speak line cites p/{id}.md, static frame remains readable without script

in_scope: Optional support only; Commons remains open

default_acceptance_rows.when: A public-safe support receipt is published
default_acceptance_rows.then: The receipt reconciles without private buyer data

in_scope: One calendar month of named presence

default_acceptance_rows.then: UNKNOWN — binding records the gap; this composer will not invent an acceptance test
